step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts a monitoring integration between a customer's AWS environment and CrowdStrike's environment. On the customer AWS side, an EC2 instance logs activities to CloudTrail. S3 stores CloudTrail logs and triggers an SNS notification on log creation. On the CrowdStrike side, SNS forwards notifications to an SQS queue, which notifies the CrowdStrike Cloud Connector (running on EC2). The Cloud Connector then fetches and enriches the CloudTrail logs directly from the customer's S3 bucket.
